The '''RGC-16 airspeeder''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] model in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:RGC16-EP.png|thumb|left|180px|A blue RGC-16 speeder]]
An RGC-16 airspeeder was used by [[Cassie Cryar/Legends|Cassie Cryar]] and [[Ione Marcy/Legends|Ione Marcy]] to escape [[Nack Movers/Legends|Nack Movers's]] apartment after killing him and taking [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber]], which he had bought from [[Bannamu/Legends|Bannamu]]. During the [[Plot to assassinate Satine Kryze/Legends|assassination attempts]] on [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Kryze]] fooled the [[Police droid/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|authorities]] by thinking that she was driving an RGC-16 airspeeder. [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] also used one when taking [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to his [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] hideout. and later, his [[Techno-service droid/Legends|Techno-service droid]] [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]] to toss Threepio and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] back where they found them.
